threads.body: [General] This checks the cached v3-preview flag from `GlobalOpenTelemetry`, not the configuration attached to this builder's `openTelemetry`. When a library passes a non-global `ExtendedOpenTelemetry` whose `common.v3_preview` is true, the deprecated system property is still applied, contrary to the stated rule that v3 preview disables it. Resolve `v3_preview` from `commonConfig` first and use the global value only as its fallback; a test with a non-global configured instance would cover this case.

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/trask/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/ff60c254bb282acee1056a953b94d3c7a3510a46.

The builder now uses SemconvStability.v3Preview(openTelemetry), shared with #19179, and a non-global ExtendedOpenTelemetry regression test verifies the configured v3 preview value disables the deprecated property fallback.
